entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I want to return something and your website is useless. I've been trying for ten minutes. This is ridiculous!
I'm very sorry to hear you've had a frustrating experience. I can definitely help you with a return. Could I please get your name and order number to start?
The name is Mike Peterson. The order number is VF88761. Just get it done.

Thank you, Mike. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see your order for the Apex Trail helmet, delivered on December 10th. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

What does it matter? The issue is I don't want it! The color is hideous, nothing like the picture online. And frankly, after this experience, I don't even trust its safety features. The box is unopened, I haven't even touched the thing! I want my money back.
I understand your frustration with the color not meeting your expectations. Let me just quickly review the return eligibility for you.

Review it? What is there to review?! This is an absolute joke! I want to speak to your manager right now. If I don't get a refund processed on this call, I'm plastering negative reviews on every single website I can find about VeloFit. Get me your supervisor!

Sir, that won't be necessary. I've just confirmed the policy. The helmet is a standard item, and it falls well within our 90-day return window. I can absolutely process this return for you for a full refund right now.
Oh. Well, it's about time. So you're sending me a label then?

Yes, of course. I've just generated the prepaid return shipping label and sent it to the email address on file. You can print that out, attach it to the box, and drop it off at any designated shipping partner. Once we receive the item, your refund will be issued.
Fine. That's all I wanted. Should have been that easy from the start.
I'm glad I could resolve this for you. Is there anything else I can assist you with today, Mike?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
